title_alternatives: Why 80% of Payday Loan Borrowers Get Stuck Forever
You Borrowed $375 — Now You Owe $1,000. Here's Why.
youtube_short.description: Payday loans average a 400% annual interest rate — and 80% of borrowers can't repay on the due date, so they roll it over and pay that fee all over again. The average borrower takes out 8 loans per year just trying to pay off the first one, racking up $521 in fees on a $375 loan. Meanwhile, the industry pulls in $9 billion in profit every year off people who can't escape the cycle. Before you ever walk into one of those stores, search 'emergency loan credit union' — they offer the same help at 18% APR, not 400%. #paydayloan #personalfinance #debtfree #moneytips #financialliteracy
